text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a powerful performance! And the
winner of
the Copa Republica Argentina
is...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Yesss!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... Aren't there like... senior runners
here?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That means I can actually hold my own...
I'm, like,
on fire!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I could even...

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay, Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! What did we just watch?
How did
she get so freaking good?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right! Our girl is a real
powerhouse!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We can't let her leave us behind! Time
to train
like there's no tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: JORDAAAN! You go, girl!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aha... ahaha! So loud!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just getting started! I'm gonna go
even higher!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it even bigger! Next
stop, the...
the, uh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'm counting on ya. It's a pretty
huge
G1, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her big announcement at the

racecourse, Tosen Jordan brings up the
Arima
Kinen with me in the most casual
tone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I already said I'd do it, so now I've
gotta,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show the girls just how cool I can
be.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hm... From a medical standpoint, I have
no
objections. In fact, I think any race
should be just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What? But I want to run in the Arima,
not just any
race! I read that it's a legit
killer race!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's not exactly what I meant... I just
mean that
your nails have completely
healed.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to your hard work in taking
care of
them. I don't have any concerns
now—they look
clean and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Like, for real, for real? You're
not
messing with me right now?!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes, for real. You took great care
of
yourself. It's almost a miracle they
healed as well
as they did.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A miracle...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You should thank your trainer for
coming here so
often to consult with me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I already do. I do a bunch of stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But, well...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What's with the tone?! Are you making
fun of
me?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're such a dummy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A week later, one rumor in particular is
making
the rounds among the trainers.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's all about the Tiara tour this year. I
hear there's
one runner who already has
international races in
her sights.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I were to say who the strongest
runner is
currently, it'd have to be
someone from the Tiara
tour...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about the strongest in
general. Don't
forget who we're about to
see in the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
True, the field is basically a who's who in
racing at
this point. I guess we'll see
who's really the
strongest at the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We got a meteor touchdown tomorrow...
Looks
like it's fixin' to be a stellar
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: It's all over... I should call my mom...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! ☆ We'll be guiding one lucky
individual
to Mars! ♪ The boarding gate
is that tire right
over there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Cut it out! What're you trying
to pull?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tell me the value of pi!
3.1415926535... and
what's next?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Too slow! How are you supposed to fend
off the
Turfians' attack like that?! Next
trainer, you're up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The heck's going on?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Incredibly stupid, more like. She's so
extra.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But every time she races, she's always
the favorite
or at least second. I don't
get it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who can't solve the problem, hit
the tire!
I'll let you use my custom
hammer!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hammer training is an effective method
for
building muscle, but it's unclear why
she's
involving other people like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: 行動の裏に考えも一応あったり……？
choice_data_list_en: Was there actually some thought behind those actions...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Is this like a weird habit of yours? You're
always
trying to tie everything in with
training. I think
your brain might legit be
broken.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There's no deeper meaning. It's just
Golshi being
Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I need to focus! I
gotta keep
my eyes on the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. But I can do it, right? I
mean...
choice_data_list: 『有馬記念』は厳しいレースになるぞ
『有馬記念』は厳しいレースになると思う
choice_data_list_en: The Arima Kinen will be a tough race.
I think the Arima Kinen will be a tough race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You saw how I ran in the Copa Republica

Argentina! I can hold my own against
seniors!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We can at least see if I'm in the running.
Like,
take a look at this fan poll.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm twenty-eighth right now! Isn't that
wild? I only
just announced I wanted to
run the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That means people are already
expecting big
things of me. I could even
be number one by the
time of the race.

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! We decided on a place for the
Arima
after-party! Check the group chat!
choice_data_list_en: But the Gâ  and Gâ¡ races are...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've made it this far somehow.
All we can
do is try our best, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that so nonchalantly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's up to you to figure out how we do
that. And
as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm... just a dummy. That means it's all up
to you!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Check this out! It's a list of all the
runners in
the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. It's all anyone's talking
about. It's an
impressive lineup, right?
...Ah, there's a name that
takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan! She was a hot topic back
in the
Satsuki Sho, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from like six months ago? Forget
about her,
my fave is running! You know
her, right? She's—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...One month left until the Arima Kinen.
